description: Currency + amount as ONE typed value. Amounts are string-scaled minor units (BigInt arithmetic — floating point never touches money). Multi-currency is representation only: conversion is a provider concern, explicitly out of scope; mixing currencies is a typed PAYMENTS_CURRENCY_MISMATCH failure.

minorUnits.description: Canonical decimal string of minor units (<= 2^53-1, no leading zeros).

title: Arena money value v1
